figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. (A) Comparative HPLC analysis of multi-time-point culture extracts of the ΔbmmB strain. Bacillaenes were produced at an early stage
and mostly degraded after 36 h, while diﬃcidins (marked by gray asterisks) started to be generated from 6 h. (B) Antibacterial assay of 3−12 h
culture extracts of the ΔbmmB mutant strain against multi-drug-resistant (MDR) bacterial strains (a. Enterococcus faecium CCARM 5203; b.
Escherichia coli CCARM 1009; c. Salmonella typhimurium CCARM 8250).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. DANS-SVI-based 2D NMR metabolomic analysis (in CD3OD, 600 MHz at 274 K) of the 3 h culture extract of the ΔbmmB strain. (A)
The HSQC spectrum was overlaid with the intensity ratio of 0.15:1, which are shown in blue and gray, respectively. The signals of compound 1
were picked up and marked with red crossbars. (B) The DQF-COSY spectrum of the 3 h culture extract was overlaid with the intensity ratio of
0.13:1, and the COSY correlations of 1 were connected by red lines. Overlaying of the single NMR spectrum with varied intensities was
accomplished using the MestReNova 6.1.0 software (step 1: superimpose the selected single spectrum; step 2: set up the stacked spectra to
preferred colors; step 3: scale the intensities of the stacked spectra into appropriate values for peak picking of target compounds).

Figure 3. DANS-SVI-based NMR assignments of Fr. gBAEs (in CD3OD, 600 MHz at 274 K). (A) DQF-COSY spectrum of Fr. gBAEs was
overlaid with the intensity ratio of 1:2.8:9.5. The observed COSY correlations of 4, 3, and 5 are connected by red, blue, and pink lines, respectively.
(B) HSQC spectrum of Fr. gBAEs was overlaid with the intensity ratio of 1:2.4:4.8, which are shown in red, blue, and gray, respectively. The
overlaying of the single NMR spectrum with varied intensities was accomplished using the MestReNova 6.1.0 software.
